The Shop

A Northside Institution

Some shops cut hair. This one raised a neighborhood. For more than a decade, A Touch of Elegance has been where Northside Jacksonville comes for sharp fades, fresh locs, silk press Sundays-ready styles — and conversation that feels like home.

Owner Sheila Edwards trained at Roffler Hair Design College and built this shop on one simple promise: every head that sits in a chair here gets treated like family. Twelve-year clients. Three generations in the same afternoon. That's not marketing — that's the room.

— Barber & beauty, under one roof.
